calendar_period_overrides_dates.name: calendar_period_overrides_dates
calendar_period_overrides_dates.value:
case when "calendar_period_overrides"."action" = 'move'
        then "calendar_period_overrides"."start_date" is not null and "calendar_period_overrides"."end_date" is not null and "calendar_period_overrides"."start_date" <= "calendar_period_overrides"."end_date"
        else num_nulls("calendar_period_overrides"."start_date", "calendar_period_overrides"."end_date") = 2
        end

calendar_periods_dates.name: calendar_periods_dates
calendar_periods_dates.value:
case when "calendar_periods"."recurrence" = 'once'
        then "calendar_periods"."start_date" is not null and "calendar_periods"."end_date" is not null and "calendar_periods"."start_date" <= "calendar_periods"."end_date"
          and num_nulls("calendar_periods"."start_month", "calendar_periods"."start_day", "calendar_periods"."end_month", "calendar_periods"."end_day", "calendar_periods"."valid_from", "calendar_periods"."valid_until") = 6
        else num_nulls("calendar_periods"."start_date", "calendar_periods"."end_date") = 2
          and num_nonnulls("calendar_periods"."start_month", "calendar_periods"."start_day", "calendar_periods"."end_month", "calendar_periods"."end_day", "calendar_periods"."valid_from") = 5
          and "calendar_periods"."start_month" between 1 and 12 and "calendar_periods"."end_month" between 1 and 12
          and "calendar_periods"."start_day" between 1 and 31 and "calendar_periods"."end_day" between 1 and 31
          and ("calendar_periods"."valid_until" is null or "calendar_periods"."valid_from" <= "calendar_periods"."valid_until")
        end

calendar_periods_season.name: calendar_periods_season
calendar_periods_season.value:
("calendar_periods"."kind" = 'season') = ("calendar_periods"."week" is not null and "calendar_periods"."rank" is not null)
        and ("calendar_periods"."week" is null or jsonb_typeof("calendar_periods"."week") = 'object')
        and ("calendar_periods"."kind" = 'season' or num_nulls("calendar_periods"."week", "calendar_periods"."rank") = 2)

files_detected.name: files_detected
files_detected.value: "files"."state" = 'uploading' or ("files"."content_type" is not null and "files"."sha256" is not null)

positions_unit_or_retired.name: positions_unit_or_retired
positions_unit_or_retired.value: "positions"."unit_id" is not null or "positions"."retired_at" is not null

requests_accepted_columns.name: requests_accepted_columns
requests_accepted_columns.value:
("requests"."state" in ('in_progress', 'completed', 'rejected_no_response')) = (
        "requests"."handler_id" is not null and "requests"."workflow_id" is not null and "requests"."workflow_version_id" is not null
        and "requests"."accepted_at" is not null and "requests"."accepted_by" is not null
      )

requests_not_accepted_columns.name: requests_not_accepted_columns
requests_not_accepted_columns.value:
"requests"."state" in ('in_progress', 'completed', 'rejected_no_response') or (
        "requests"."handler_id" is null and "requests"."workflow_id" is null and "requests"."workflow_version_id" is null
        and "requests"."handler_unit_id" is null and "requests"."accepted_at" is null and "requests"."accepted_by" is null
      )

requests_closed_columns.name: requests_closed_columns
requests_closed_columns.value: ("requests"."state" not in ('in_review', 'in_progress')) = ("requests"."closed_at" is not null and "requests"."closed_by" is not null)

requests_sla_record.name: requests_sla_record
requests_sla_record.value:
("requests"."state" in ('completed', 'rejected_no_response')) = (
        "requests"."sla_deadline" is not null and "requests"."elapsed_days" is not null and "requests"."breach_days" is not null
        and "requests"."awaiting_info_days" is not null and "requests"."sla_met" is not null
      )

requests_sla_record_absent.name: requests_sla_record_absent
requests_sla_record_absent.value:
"requests"."state" in ('completed', 'rejected_no_response') or (
        "requests"."sla_deadline" is null and "requests"."elapsed_days" is null and "requests"."breach_days" is null
        and "requests"."awaiting_info_days" is null and "requests"."sla_met" is null
      )

tenant_members_position_has_unit.name: tenant_members_position_has_unit
tenant_members_position_has_unit.value: "tenant_members"."position_id" is null or "tenant_members"."unit_id" is not null

users_verified_has_password.name: users_verified_has_password
users_verified_has_password.value: "users"."email_verified_at" is null or "users"."password_hash" is not null

workflow_stages_party_flags.name: workflow_stages_party_flags
workflow_stages_party_flags.value:
"workflow_stages"."target_builtin" is null or "workflow_stages"."target_builtin" not in ('handler', 'requester')
        or (not "workflow_stages"."handler_may_narrow" and not "workflow_stages"."exclude_parties")

request_stage_runs_level.name: request_stage_runs_level
request_stage_runs_level.value: ("request_stage_runs"."state" <> 'active' or "request_stage_runs"."level" is not null) and ("request_stage_runs"."state" <> 'held' or "request_stage_runs"."level" is null)
